data.narrative:
Still Bright is a Seed-stage Climate & Energy company founded by Jon Vardner and Professors Alan C. West and Scott Banta, having raised $18.7M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises nine private peers and one public comparable (LNZA), including notable private companies such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen.

A peer-median valuation approach was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow peer set; while nine companies operate in Climate & Energy, fewer than three met strict stage and tier filters necessary to avoid misleading conclusions. Accordingly, the valuation triangulation relies on a stage-progression method, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $18.7M capital raised proxy. This method yields an implied valuation of $47M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $40M to $54M, centered on a median of $47M. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer multiples at Still Bright's stage, which limits cross-validation of the stage-progression assumption, and the lack of disclosed financial metrics (revenue, burn rate, or technical milestones) that would typically refine stage-based estimates. Additional data on company-specific traction and revised peer-set filtering may narrow this range materially.
